spokenScript: Welcome home, sir. Systems are online. Here is your briefing for Saturday, the twenty-first of November. Currency. The Bank of Zambia's latest published rate, dated the twentieth of November, has the US dollar at twenty point five eight kwacha mid-rate. Buying is twenty point five six, and selling is twenty point six one. That's a slight weakening from about twenty point four seven a week ago. Email. I couldn't get into your inbox this morning. The Gmail connection needs you to sign in again, so I have no email summary for this week. Please reconnect Gmail in your Claude connector settings and I'll include it next time. Calendar. Your Google Calendar is clear. Nothing is scheduled between now and the end of January. One thing worth noting: the Bank of Zambia's Monetary Policy Rate announcement is on Thursday, the twenty-seventh of November. Tayant Pay. From the August tab of the Phoenix Tayant transaction records, Tayant Pay processed one hundred and thirteen transactions in August, not counting brought-forward balances and investor deposits. On the Zambian ledger, about one hundred and sixty-one thousand kwacha came in and about one hundred and forty-two thousand went out. On the Russian ledger, about five hundred and forty-five thousand roubles came in and about seven hundred and three thousand went out, earning roughly twelve thousand two hundred roubles in revenue. The tab also carries entries for September through November, and across the whole tab it holds three hundred and ninety transactions. That's everything for now, sir.
